prompts.title: 电影感时尚大片：祖母绿凝胶灯光运用
prompts.description: 一个高度具体的提示，用于生成极简电影风格的时尚编辑肖像，并使用参考照片来确定人物身份。它详细描述了构图（垂直 4:5，半身）、姿势、服装（风衣）和复杂的灯光设置，包括一个强烈的翠绿色凝胶主光，以及背景中圆形琥珀色/橙色“太阳”聚光灯的投射。
prompts.content: Using a person's photo as the identfy refrence, create a minimalist cinematic fashion-editorial studio portrait with dramatic colored-gel lighting: vertical 4:5, mid-torso to head framing with generous negative space above, subject placed slightly left of center: pose: shoulders angled 3/4, head turned back toward camera, chin slightly lifted: expression calm, cool, slightly aloof, lips softly parted, eyes relaxed and focused: wardrobe: clean structured trench coat or minimalist overcoat with wide lapels and a single shoulder epaulette detail, no logos, no jewelry: lighting: strong saturated emerald-green gel key from camera-right/front-right (-5200K base under green gel) wrapping the face and coat, deep falloff into shadow on the far side, subtle soft fill from camera-left at very low intensity: background: a large circular "sun" spotlight/soft projection centered behind the head with a smooth radial gradient-bright amber core (#FF8A00) fading to deep burnt orange (#C43412) and then into near-black warm brown edges (#120408), perfectly clean and textureless: optics: 85mm portrait look, 1/2-1/2.8 shallow DOF (eyes tack sharp, background creamy), gentle bloom on highlights, smooth cinematic contrast, subtle film grain, rich color separation (green subject against orange halo), crisp micro-texture in fabric weave, controlled skin texture, no text, no watermark. Editorial, modern, high-detail, cinematic composition, ultra-realistic textures, professional fashion photography style.
prompts.translatedContent: 以人物照片作为识别参考，创作一张极简电影风格的时尚编辑棚拍肖像，采用戏剧性的彩色凝胶灯光：纵向 4:5 构图，从躯干中部到头部取景，上方留有充足的负空间，主体略微偏左放置：姿势：肩膀呈 3/4 角度，头部转向相机，下巴略微抬起：表情平静、冷酷、略带疏离，嘴唇微张，眼神放松且专注：服装：干净利落的结构化风衣或极简主义大衣，带有宽翻领和单肩章细节，无标志，无首饰：灯光：从相机右侧/前右侧打来强烈的饱和祖母绿凝胶主光（绿色凝胶下为 -5200K 基色），包裹面部和外套，远侧深邃地融入阴影，相机左侧以极低强度进行柔和的补光：背景：一个大型圆形“太阳”聚光灯/柔和投影，以头部为中心，具有平滑的径向渐变——明亮的琥珀色核心（#FF8A00）逐渐淡入深焦橙色（#C43412），然后过渡到接近黑色的暖棕色边缘（#120408），完美干净且无纹理：光学：85mm 人像镜头效果，1/2-1/2.8 浅景深（眼睛锐利，背景柔和），高光处有柔和的光晕，平滑的电影对比度，微妙的胶片颗粒，丰富的色彩分离（绿色主体衬托橙色光晕），织物纹理清晰的微观细节，受控的皮肤纹理，无文字，无水印。编辑风格，现代，高细节，电影构图，超现实纹理，专业时尚摄影风格。
